# Rows where HarfRust (the vendored third_party/harfrust, 0.9.0 plus its patches) differs from HarfBuzz
# 9cb1fee5: `config font source class`. Every other row is exact. A row listed here that starts
# matching, or a row that differs and is not listed, fails the replay test. Generated by classify.py.
# Modes b and c (Skia's callbacks) are exact: the differences HarfRust had there (fallback-mark-gap,
# fallback-space-advance, anchor-rounding, arabic-fallback-shaping) are fixed by the patches of
# third_party/harfrust/SKIA-RUST.md. What is left is mode a only, where HarfRust's own font
# functions stand in for Skia's callbacks, which replace them (docs/design/modules.md §2.4):
#   builtin-extents           the built-in glyph extents of HarfRust are missing where HarfBuzz has them
#                             (e.g. CFF fonts), or differ, so fallback marks get another offset.
#   builtin-advance-rounding  +-1 in 16.16 advances of the built-in font functions.
